title: what the module constant that replaces a sentinel in its callee's body actually names, and whether one name is one population
population_source: e537_constant_terminal.py::population() -- every forwarding row E532 published as 'replaced_by_module_constant', plus every module-level constant in scripts/ whose value is derived from __file__
method_limits: nothing in this repository is executed: every expression is evaluated by a whitelist interpreter with __file__ bound to the owning module's own path

the whitelist covers os.path.dirname/abspath/realpath/normpath/join, pathlib Path/PurePath construction with .resolve/.absolute/.parent/.parents[n]/.joinpath, str concatenation and expanduser; anything else is published as unresolved with the kind it named, never folded into a directory
a directory is only published when the evaluation exists on disk; a value that names a file publishes that file's directory and is counted separately as kind='names_a_file'
the corpus is scripts/ only -- a constant with the same name inside a test fixture, a Tools/ script or a legacy tree is outside this reading
the chain is followed to the deepest link the parent face published; a hop the parent did not publish is recorded with unpublished_hop and stops the chain rather than being guessed
sources_read and the corpus counts are a snapshot of a live tree other lanes write to; every class, every directory and the verdict are re-derived by verify
